name: Antero Resources
outlook:
What Antero Resources says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: productionAntero expects fourth quarter 2026 production to be approximately 4.3 Bcfe/d, reflecting an estimated 15 to 20 Bcfe of curtailments, driven by low regional pricing.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: cash production expenseCash production expense during the fourth quarter is expected to be in the range of $2.10 to $2.20 per Mcfe.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 28, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
